task.title: To unlock or lock Read-Only clauses

step.cmd: Open a generated agreement document containing Read-Only clauses.
Go to Work tab > Unlock Clauses. If there are no read-only clauses in the agreement document and you select Unlock Clauses, an error message is displayed.

info.p: All the Read-Only clauses in the agreement document become editable.

step.cmd: Make the required changes to the Read-Only clauses or delete Read-Only clauses.

info.p: To delete a Read-Only Clause, see To mark a clause for deletion.

step.cmd: Go to Work tab > Lock Clauses.

info.p: The Read-Only clauses become uneditable. You cannot undo changes after the Read-Only clauses are locked.
If you do not lock Read-Only clauses and check in the agreement document, the Read-Only clauses get locked.

note.p: You can view modified unlocked Read-Only clauses on the Reconciliation page or Agreement Clause tab.
